en: The image depicts a historical square with several large buildings, likely hotels or villas, and a central monument surrounded by a small, landscaped park with trimmed trees and flowerbeds. The style and tone of the image suggest it is an old postcard, possibly from the early 20th century. The text on the image includes a greeting from Pyrmont and references 'Kaiserplatz,' which appears to be the name of the square. The card is published by F. Pietsch in Pyrmont.
